label: Diagram 3.9
caption: Diagram 3.9 Floor types 1.1C and 1.2B | – wall type 2
description: The drawing is a section, marked "SECTION" at the lower right, titled "Diagram 3.9 Floor types 1.1C and 1.2B – wall type 2". It shows a vertical separating wall passing between two different floor constructions. The wall is drawn as two cross-hatched leaves with a cavity between them, running vertically both above and below the floor level, and is identified by the label "Separating wall type 2" at the bottom. On the left, a stippled horizontal slab resting on two hatched support symbols is labelled "Floor type 1.1C"; a thin element at its edge against the wall is labelled "Timber batten". On the right, a floor of a different build, showing a row of circular voids above a wavy-lined base, is labelled "Floor type 1.2B". The left floor meets the left leaf of the wall and the right floor meets the right leaf. Above the floor level the wall continues as the same two cross-hatched leaves with a cavity between them, pointed to by the label "Separating floor type 1 carried through to cavity face". A dimension with two arrows at the bottom right reads "Minimum 300mm", spanning the right-hand part of the wall.
